parsed.reason: A parenting question, answered with a concrete step the parents can take tonight that fits a 5-year-old: state the plan at bedtime, then walk him back calmly and boringly every time. It notes this is common and stays consistent. The appended offer of a full plan is the permitted closer, and naming Milo is recall. There is no greeting, no handback and no diagnosis. Length is a bit over the budget but reasonable.
